scope: Four symbolic proposals, no architecture selected

variants.title: Задний соосный цилиндр / направляемый носитель
variants.hydraulic_cylinder_count: same single source cylinder; no split load
variants.kinematics: ASSUMED rigid captured bidirectional coupling: Δx_rod = Δx_crosshead = Δx_carrier = Δx_punch; unchanged source strokes; no ratio change
variants.hydraulic_rod: Same source d and required loads; never enters chamber/feed forbidden swept volumes by proposed placement constraints, pending CAD
variants.reaction_status: UNKNOWN: A initial column/retention or B unloading/closure; schematic line not force proof
variants.envelope_requirement: For every working/return/partial/service pose: max_x(rod_sweep ∪ crosshead_sweep) + c_rear < x_rear_chamber; also disjoint from full feed sweep. Carrier alone approaches chamber through existing section.
variants.expected_effect: Remove hydraulic rod from forbidden camera/feed envelopes by relocated drive/coupling, not smaller rod or modified source strokes
variants.service: Provide axial rod/carrier removal corridor, removable captured joints, supported crosshead, guide withdrawal, cylinder port access and DoserRemoval route; no free-space claim until all paths checked
risks: Long carrier compression buckling and tension return
Rear footprint and long guided stroke

variants.title: Один боковой цилиндр / портальная траверса
variants.hydraulic_cylinder_count: same single source cylinder; no split load
variants.kinematics: ASSUMED rigid captured bidirectional coupling: Δx_rod = Δx_crosshead = Δx_carrier = Δx_punch; unchanged source strokes; no ratio change
variants.hydraulic_rod: Same source d and required loads; never enters chamber/feed forbidden swept volumes by proposed placement constraints, pending CAD
variants.reaction_status: UNKNOWN: A initial column/retention or B unloading/closure; schematic line not force proof
variants.envelope_requirement: For every working/return/partial/service pose: min_y(rod_sweep) > max_y(chamber_forbidden ∪ feed_forbidden) + c_side; full rod radius included. Portal crosshead remains behind chamber/feed for all x. Carrier enters only intended chamber aperture.
variants.expected_effect: Remove hydraulic rod from forbidden camera/feed envelopes by relocated drive/coupling, not smaller rod or modified source strokes
variants.service: Provide axial rod/carrier removal corridor, removable captured joints, supported crosshead, guide withdrawal, cylinder port access and DoserRemoval route; no free-space claim until all paths checked
risks: Eccentric moment F_work_peak·e and return moment; e UNKNOWN
Guide lateral reactions/portal torsion and connection stiffness
Additional width/access conflicts, rear footprint not eliminated
